title: Quantum Computing Essentials with Qiskit (PYTH_171_S1 to PYTH_171_S8)

slides.title: Quantum Qubits & Circuits
slides.prompt: Quantum computing uses superposition and entanglement to solve complex computational problems using quantum gates.
slides.codeSnippet:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(2, 2)
qc.h(0)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.measure([0, 1], [0, 1])

slides.title: Hadamard Superposition Gate
slides.prompt: Fill in the method used in Qiskit to apply a Hadamard gate and place a qubit into superposition.

slides.title: Quantum Entanglement Gate
slides.prompt: Which quantum gate pair creates a maximum entanglement (Bell State) when starting from ground state |00⟩?
options: Hadamard gate on qubit 0, followed by CNOT (CX) gate from 0 to 1
Pauli-Z gate on qubit 0, followed by SWAP gate
slides.correctAnswer: Hadamard gate on qubit 0, followed by CNOT (CX) gate from 0 to 1

slides.title: Controlled-NOT Gate
slides.prompt: Fill in the Qiskit method name for applying a Controlled-NOT (CNOT) gate between control and target qubits.

slides.title: Qubit Superposition Concept
slides.prompt: What allows a qubit in superposition to perform simultaneous calculations unlike a classical bit?
options: Existing in a linear combination of both |0⟩ and |1⟩ states simultaneously until measured
Operating at clock speeds exceeding 100 GHz
Storing values as floating-point numbers in GPU RAM
Eliminating all heating losses using superconductor cables
slides.correctAnswer: Existing in a linear combination of both |0⟩ and |1⟩ states simultaneously until measured

slides.title: Measuring Quantum Circuits
slides.prompt: Fill in the method used to collapse quantum states into classical register bits.

slides.title: Quantum Simulators vs Hardware
slides.prompt: Why do developers execute quantum circuits on local statevector simulators before cloud quantum processing units (QPUs)?
options: To test circuit logic deterministically without noise or queue wait times
Because simulators support an infinite number of physical qubits
Because physical QPUs cannot execute Hadamard gates
Simulators run faster for 1,000+ qubit systems
slides.correctAnswer: To test circuit logic deterministically without noise or queue wait times

slides.title: Pauli-X Gate (Quantum NOT)
slides.prompt: Fill in the single-qubit gate method equivalent to a classical bitwise NOT operation.
